title: My new game Ironaut done in Opus 5.5. Build your mech, base, vehicles, and take back control from the machines.
author: Mekkablood
selftext:
This is something I've been working on for awhile, and hope it's finally at a good spot to show. Controls similar to an mmo, also has a long quest chain, but your main goal is to build your base and protect it at night. You build bases in other locations and essentially take the planet back(not earth). [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5546950/Ironaut/?beta=0](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5546950/Ironaut/?beta=0)

Built in Opus 5.5 and has been probably my favorite project to work on. No mcp's at all. I just started small then build it up from there. Making a game is essentially writing a book now. I just explain what I want in great detail, and do the opposite of one shotting. The smaller you start the more you can dial in what you want whether it's characters, levels, or buildings.

comments.author: FoodTimely8137
comments.body:
This looks super cool! The concept of building bases in different locations to take back an alien planet while managing defenses for the night sounds like a lot of fun.
​I really like your philosophy on starting small and building it up iteratively instead of trying to one-shot everything. It definitely shows that taking the time to dial in the details—from characters to buildings—pays off. Just checked out the Steam page, and I wish you the best of luck as you keep developing it!

comments.author: holeycheezuscrust
comments.body: This looks great but I think you should really describe your use of AI on your Steam page. If you just say the game's content was AI then it makes it seem like this includes the concept and mechanics. Basically that you one-shotted it.

replies.author: Mekkablood
replies.body: If someone is anti ai it doesn't matter how you use it. They don't care this took a books size of text to create this. It's not anywhere close to possible to one shot something like this. If they are anti ai I hope they think I one shotted this and stay away.

replies.author: holeycheezuscrust
replies.body: I think it's more complicated. Most people aren't anti-AI or AI boosters they're somewhere in the middle. I know it's not possible to one-shot your game but no one else does. Nothing on your Steam page explains that, so people will think it by default and label it AI slop. Which is absolutely what you don't want.

replies.author: Mekkablood
replies.body: If someone is in the middle, I don't want them playing my game.

replies.author: holeycheezuscrust
replies.body: That’s a weird stance but ok
